verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents Gusto syncing payroll journal entries to QuickBooks, Xero or any other accounting software. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit. One is a general statement that Gusto's app-integrations program 'works with' accounting apps, with no journal-entry sync described. The others are developer building blocks: payroll reports and a payroll.paid webhook that a developer could use to build such a sync.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can sync payroll journal entries automatically to my accounting software like QuickBooks or Xero
